data.title: Seyond Holdings Clears Key LiDAR Patent Suits as Hesai Withdraws Cases
data.description:
An announcement from TechStar Acquisition Corporation Class A ( (HK:2665) ) is now available.

Seyond Holdings has provided an update on two patent infringement lawsuits brought by Hesai Technology in the Hangzhou Intermediate People’s Court, both concerning LiDAR-related patents. After the China National Intellectual Property Administration declared the disputed patents invalid in their entirety, Hesai applied to withdraw both cases, and the court issued rulings permitting the withdrawals, thereby concluding the litigation.

With the patents ruled invalid, Chinese patent law treats them as if they never existed, effectively removing potential IP constraints on Seyond’s LiDAR products. The resolution eliminates ongoing legal uncertainty for the group, clarifying its operating environment and potentially strengthening its competitive and legal position in the LiDAR technology market.
